chunks: And only then will he receive his recompense in full;
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to receive the 'full recompense' in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the perfection of divine justice (Adl), affirming that Allah’s recompense is not merely proportional but complete and without any deficiency or injustice. It serves as a theological counterpoint to human notions of partial justice, emphasizing that the Hereafter will fully actualize the potential of every deed, whether good or evil. This concept reinforces the belief in the ultimate fairness of God, where even the smallest act is weighed with absolute precision.
